# NEW 2026-11-19 Yuan track Y7 (the late-Yuan suppression of the Red Turbans, oe_y7_). Generated by gen_yuan_y7.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Ming (MNG) death diagnostic hooks + WP13 Pillar 2 Red Turban military suppression rewards.
on_military_annexed = { on_actions = { oe_y7_mng_military_annexed oe_y7_rtr_rebel_suppressed } }
on_diplomatic_annexed = { on_actions = { oe_y7_mng_diplomatic_annexed } }
on_civil_war_annexed = { on_actions = { oe_y7_mng_civil_war_annexed } }
on_annexed = { on_actions = { oe_y7_mng_generic_annexed } }

# WP13 Pillar 2: militarily annexing a Red Turban rebel faction restores stability, legitimacy, mandate & momentum!
oe_y7_rtr_rebel_suppressed = {
    trigger = {
        tag = CHI
        oe_yp_yuan_fallen = no
        is_situation_active = situation:red_turban_rebellions
        exists = scope:target
        scope:target = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_y7_suppress_rewarded }
            OR = {
                is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:red_turban_rebels
                tag = MNG
                tag = CSO
                tag = CHE
                tag = WUU
                tag = CTW
                tag = CFN
                tag = CMO
                tag = CXI
                tag = CGU
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { set_variable = oe_y7_suppress_rewarded }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:target = {
                    OR = {
                        tag = MNG
                        tag = CSO
                        tag = CHE
                        tag = WUU
                        tag = CTW
                    }
                }
            }
            add_stability = 8
            add_legitimacy = 6
            change_celestial_authority = { value = 8 }
            oe_y7_add_shi_direct = { amount = 6 }
        }
        else = {
            add_stability = 5
            add_legitimacy = 4
            oe_y7_add_shi_direct = { amount = 4 }
        }
    }
}
